
################## localhost testing ######################

# 1. POST Request (Signup)
# UTF8 encoded request for Greek characters
$body = @{
    firstName = "Όνομα"
    lastName = "Επίθετο"
    email = "email@example3.com"
    age = 25
} | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5182/api/vrpark/signup" -Method POST -Body ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)) -ContentType "application/json; charset=utf-8" 

# 2. GET Request (Verify)
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5182/api/vrpark/verify/1" -Method GET # for user with id 1

# 3. POST Request (Start Session)
$sessionBody = @{
    userId = 1
} | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5182/api/vrpark/session/start" -Method POST -Body ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($sessionBody)) -ContentType "application/json; charset=utf-8"

# 4. POST Request (End Session)
$endSessionBody = @{
    sessionId = 3
    userId = 1
    eyetrackingSequence = ""
} | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5182/api/vrpark/session/end" -Method POST -Body ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($endSessionBody)) -ContentType "application/json; charset=utf-8"

# 5. GET Request (Database Users) - Requires admin key
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5182/api/vrpark/database/users" -Method GET -Headers @{"X-Admin-Key"="DIOIKITO_VR_2025"}

# 6. GET Request (Database Sessions) - Requires admin key
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5182/api/vrpark/database/sessions" -Method GET -Headers @{"X-Admin-Key"="DIOIKITO_VR_2025"}
